entities.name: computerized maintenance management system
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: A computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) is any software package that maintains a computer database of information about an organization's maintenance operations. This information is intended to help maintenance workers do their jobs more effectively and to help management make informed decisions.
